items.name: Vidya Setu
items.subtitle: Online Examination & Olympiad Platform
items.summary: Run online exams and paid Olympiads across institutions, with live monitoring and fee collection.
items.description: Vidya Setu is an online examination and Olympiad platform. Institutions, staff and students are managed in one place; exams are scheduled, monitored live and reported on; and Olympiad registrations and fees are collected online.

items.description: Comprehensive healthcare management platform enabling patients to book appointments, manage medical records and communicate with healthcare providers seamlessly.

items.name: FleetMint
items.subtitle: Fleet Management System
items.summary: GPS tracking, maintenance, drivers and routes for your whole fleet.
items.description: Vehicle fleet management solution with GPS tracking, maintenance scheduling, driver management and route optimisation.

items.name: Student Portal

items.name: Food Ordering App
items.subtitle: Restaurant & Catering Solution
items.summary: Complete food ordering, menu management, delivery tracking and customer engagement.
items.description: Complete food delivery solution with restaurant management, order tracking, payment processing and real-time delivery updates for a better customer experience.

items.name: Garage Management
items.subtitle: Vehicle Service & Workshop Software
items.summary: Run your garage end to end: appointments, job cards, inspections, estimates, inventory and billing.
items.description: Garage Management is a complete system for vehicle garages and service workshops, across one or many branches. Book appointments, open job cards, run inspection checklists, get estimates approved by customers, manage parts and suppliers, and bill with cash, UPI, card or bank payments.
features: Billing, invoices & payments (cash, UPI, card, bank)
